def _terminals(bench: Bench, stem: str) -> list[dict]:
    return [event.body for event in bench.journal.read() if event.type == EventType.STATE_TRANSITION and event.ticket == stem and event.body.get("to") != "running"]


def _first_attempt_events(bench: Bench, stem: str):
    events = bench.journal.read()
    terminal_at = next(index for index, event in enumerate(events) if event.type == EventType.STATE_TRANSITION and event.ticket == stem and event.body.get("to") != "running")
    return events[: terminal_at + 1]
